english_meaning: A recognisable building, structure, or feature used as a point of reference or of cultural significance.
gujarati_meaning: પ્રસિદ્ધ ઇમારત અથવા સ્થળ જે દિશા ઓળખવા અથવા સાંસ્કૃતિક મહત્ત્વ માટે જાણીતું હોય.
usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'a landmark decision' means an important turning point.
examples: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark.
We visited all the landmarks in the city.
The landmark was visible from miles away.
She photographed every landmark on the tour.

english_meaning: The activity of visiting places of interest as a tourist.
gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસી તરીકે રસપ્રદ જગ્યાઓ જોવા ફરવાની પ્રવૃત્તિ.
usage_note: Often done on foot, by bus, or on a guided tour.
examples: We spent the morning sightseeing in Rome.
The sightseeing tour lasted three hours.
She loves sightseeing wherever she travels.
A double-decker bus is great for sightseeing in London.

english_meaning: A place of historical, cultural, or natural importance, often protected by law or UNESCO.
gujarati_meaning: ઐતિહાસિક, સાંસ્કૃતિક અથવા કુદરતી દ્રષ્ટિએ મહત્ત્વપૂર્ણ સ્થળ — ઘણીવાર UNESCO દ્વારા સુરક્ષિત.
usage_note: UNESCO designates World Heritage Sites for outstanding universal value.
memory_tip: Heritage = વારસો → heritage site = વારસાનું સ્થળ.
examples: The Taj Mahal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
We visited three heritage sites in one day.
Heritage sites must be protected for future generations.
India has over 40 UNESCO heritage sites.

english_meaning: A building where objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are displayed.
gujarati_meaning: ઇમારત — જ્યાં ઐતિહાસિક, વૈજ્ઞાનિક, કલા અથવા સાંસ્કૃતિક વસ્તુઓ પ્રદર્શિત કરાય.
usage_note: Many museums offer free entry on certain days or for students.
examples: The British Museum has millions of artefacts.
We spent the afternoon at the science museum.
The museum was free on Sundays.
She works as a guide at the local history museum.

english_meaning: A public display of art, artefacts, or objects for people to view.
gujarati_meaning: જાહેર પ્રદર્શન — જ્યાં કળા, ઐતિહાસિક વસ્તુઓ અથવા ઉત્પાદનો લોકો જોઈ શકે.
usage_note: 'Exhibition' is the event; 'exhibit' is an individual item on display.
memory_tip: Exhibit (દેખાડવું) + ion = exhibition = ઘણું દેખાડવું — show.
examples: The photography exhibition attracted thousands of visitors.
We saw a special exhibition on ancient Egypt.
The gallery is hosting a temporary exhibition this month.
She entered her artwork in the local exhibition.

english_meaning: A tour of a place led by a knowledgeable guide who explains the significance of what is seen.
gujarati_meaning: જ્ઞાની ગાઇડ સાથેની ટૂર — જ્યાં ગાઇડ દરેક સ્થળ વિશે સ્પષ્ટ કરે.
usage_note: Guided tours are ideal for first-time visitors who want historical context.
memory_tip: Guide (ગાઇડ) + ed = guided → someone guides you through.
examples: We booked a guided tour of the old city.
The guided tour included entry to all major attractions.
Our guide on the guided tour was very knowledgeable.
A private guided tour costs more but is more flexible.

english_meaning: A planned route or schedule for a sightseeing trip.
gujarati_meaning: સ્થળ-ભ્રમણ માટેની વિગતવાર યોજના અને સમય-ક્રમ.
usage_note: A sightseeing itinerary helps prioritise which attractions to visit.
memory_tip: Iter (path in Latin) → itinerary = path plan for sightseeing.
examples: Our sightseeing itinerary covered five museums in two days.
The guide adjusted the itinerary due to bad weather.
We followed the itinerary strictly on the first day.
She created a custom itinerary for the cultural district.

english_meaning: The remains of old buildings or structures from ancient civilisations.
gujarati_meaning: પ્રાચીન સभ्यताना જૂના ખંડેરો — ઇમારતો અથવા બાંધકામના અવશેષો.
usage_note: Many ancient ruins are protected archaeological sites with restricted access.
memory_tip: Ancient = પ્રાચીન + ruins = ખંડેર → ancient ruins = પ્રાચીન ખંડેર.
examples: We explored the ancient ruins of Pompeii.
The ancient ruins were surprisingly well preserved.
Archaeologists discovered ancient ruins beneath the city.
Ancient ruins attract millions of tourists each year.

english_meaning: An object bought or kept as a reminder of a visit to a place.
gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળ-મુલાકાતની યાદ તરીકે ખરીદાયેલ અથવા રાખેલ વસ્તુ.
usage_note: From French meaning 'to remember'; souvenir shops are found at most tourist attractions.
memory_tip: Souvenir sounds like 'remember' in French — something to remember a place by.
examples: She bought a small souvenir from every country she visited.
The souvenir shop was crowded with tourists.
He chose a hand-painted ceramic as his souvenir.
Souvenirs don't have to be expensive to be meaningful.

english_meaning: An unobstructed wide view of a landscape or cityscape in all directions.
gujarati_meaning: ચારે બાજુ ફેલાયેલ અવરોધ-રહિત વ્યાપક દૃશ્ય — ભૂ-દ્રશ્ય અથવા શહેરનો.
usage_note: Often found at hilltops, observation towers, or rooftop restaurants.
memory_tip: Pan (બધી દિશા) + orama (દૃશ્ય) → panoramic = ચારે તરફ દૃશ્ય.
examples: The hilltop offered a panoramic view of the valley.
We took photos from the panoramic observation deck.
The restaurant had a panoramic view of the harbour.
The panoramic view of Paris from the Eiffel Tower is stunning.

english_meaning: A public celebration of a community's traditions, arts, food, and culture.
gujarati_meaning: સમુદાયની પરંપરા, કળા, ખાદ્ય અને સંસ્કૃતિ ઉજવવાનો જાહેર ઉત્સવ.
usage_note: Cultural festivals are excellent opportunities to experience local traditions authentically.
examples: We attended a colourful cultural festival in Jaipur.
The cultural festival featured traditional music and dance.
Local artisans sold crafts at the cultural festival.
The city's annual cultural festival draws thousands of tourists.

english_meaning: The art and practice of designing and constructing buildings; the style of buildings in a place.
gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતો ડિઝાઇન અને બાંધવાની કળા; અથવા કોઈ સ્થળની ઇમારતોની શૈલી.
usage_note: Many travelers visit cities specifically to admire the architecture.
memory_tip: Archi (chief) + tecture (building) → architecture = chief building art.
examples: The city is famous for its Gothic architecture.
She studied architecture before becoming a travel writer.
The colonial architecture of Old Havana is breathtaking.
Modern and ancient architecture coexist in Tokyo.

english_meaning: The traditional food and cooking style of a particular region or country.
gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ પ્રદેશ અથવા દેશની પ્રચલિત ભોજન-પ્રણાલી અને ખોરાક.
usage_note: Trying local cuisine is considered one of the best ways to experience a culture.
examples: We made sure to try the local cuisine everywhere we went.
The local cuisine was spicy but delicious.
A food tour is a great way to explore local cuisine.
She preferred local cuisine over tourist restaurants.

english_meaning: A journey to a sacred place for religious or spiritual reasons.
gujarati_meaning: ધાર્મિક અથવા આધ્યાત્મિક કારણો માટે પવિત્ર સ્થળ પર કરાતી મુસાફરી.
usage_note: Famous pilgrimage sites include Mecca, Varanasi, Jerusalem, and the Camino de Santiago.
examples: Millions make the pilgrimage to Mecca each year.
She went on a pilgrimage to Varanasi.
The Camino de Santiago is a famous pilgrimage route.
The pilgrimage took three weeks on foot.

english_meaning: A platform, usually at the top of a tall building or tower, built for visitors to view the surroundings.
gujarati_meaning: ઊંચી ઇમારત અથવા ટાવરના ટોચ પર બનાવેલ મંચ — જ્યાંથી આસ-પાસ જોઈ શકાય.
usage_note: Many observation decks have glass floors or walls for a more dramatic experience.
memory_tip: Observe (જોવું) + deck (ઉઘડો) = જોવા માટેની ઊંચી જગ્યા.
examples: The observation deck of the Burj Khalifa is 555 metres high.
We queued for an hour to get onto the observation deck.
The observation deck offered a 360-degree city view.
She was afraid to stand on the glass observation deck.

english_meaning: An outdoor market held in a street where vendors sell food, crafts, clothing, and other goods.
gujarati_meaning: ખુલ્લા મેદાનમાં અથવા શેરીમાં ભરાતો બજાર — જ્યાં ખોરાક, હસ્તકળા, કપડા વગેરે વેચાય.
usage_note: Street markets are great places to find local products and interact with residents.
examples: We browsed the street market for local crafts.
The street market was full of colour and noise.
She bought fresh spices at the street market.
The night street market in Bangkok is famous worldwide.

english_meaning: The traditional stories, customs, beliefs, and art of a community, passed down through generations.
gujarati_meaning: સમુદાયની પ્રચલિત વાર્તાઓ, રિવાજો, માન્યતાઓ અને કળા — જે પેઢી-દર-પેઢી ચાલ્યા આવ્યા.
usage_note: Folklore includes oral traditions, folk music, dance, and legends specific to a region.
memory_tip: Folk (લોક) + lore (જ્ઞાન) = folklore = લોક-જ્ઞાન — people's wisdom and stories.
examples: The guide shared fascinating local folklore about the mountains.
The museum dedicated a wing to regional folklore.
Folklore explains many of the customs we observed.
Rajasthani folklore is rich with stories of brave warriors.
